objective: Complete the semantic model using the compiler-wide gap audit, including additional defects discovered during implementation.
verified_checks: The v27 affected-layout source audit completed with all 15 cases passing: five changed modules across GCC/LLVM/Clang, full and expression exports, exact disabled/enabled code and parser-observation equality. Evidence: self-layout-v27/results.json and self-layout-v27.log. Current v28 frontend ABI implementation passes six combined families plus the production-observer guard executable, architecture checks and 19 corrected-total ABI corruptions. It distinguishes value/implicit-reference/reference/descriptor/variadic formals, actual slot widths, instance ordinals and frontend result kinds across high-level and native assembler backends. Evidence: frontend-abi-families-v28-complete.log, frontend-abi-final-guards-v28.log. Descriptor flags now name native VAR, FIELD and STRUCT descriptor roles. The v28 ABI source audit is running with one worker; no complete source acceptance is claimed yet.

Nine existing namespace, array/forward-type, declaration, pool-lifetime and aggregate membership/access families pass on v27 (layout-regressions-v27.log). Four additional architecture controls pass for Amiga/m68k, RISC OS/ARM, Windows CE/ARM and Linux/AArch64, with a diagnostic/no-complete-model control for this driver's unsupported JS target (layout-architectures-v27-complete.log). The cross-target run found and repaired a reader assumption that descriptor alignment equalled pointer storage: m68k pointers are four bytes with two-byte alignment. The current source audit has eight saved passing cases of fifteen; it remains incomplete.

v27 BASIC layout observers and independent reader pass seven focused families together, including 12 backend/target packing partitions, storage decisions, native runtime behavior, stateful macro callbacks, repeated includes, QB defaults, transport/reset, parser restart, diagnostic equality and rollback. Twenty-seven additional corruption cases reject invented or missing layout facts, including deleted logical fields and omitted/duplicate relocations with adjusted counts. Evidence: layout-families-v27-complete.log, layout-corruption-v27.log. Native descriptor attributes are now correctly named on FIELD as well as VAR symbols. Compiler structure checks 299 documented files / 21 host graphs; binary contract matches. The affected-source audit is running with one worker and is not claimed complete.

The current forward/alias array corruption control passes all three backends after retaining a coherent native T/NT pair. It therefore still exercises the higher-level array element selection guard instead of failing early at NT integrity. Evidence: array-type-closure-v25-complete.log. The frozen v24 suite retains the older assertion fixture and is not claimed wholly passing.

v25 native BASIC implementation passes eight current families together: 100 class-aware flag definitions; all 32 bits, zero/all masks and invalid mapper bounds/classes/groups; live common/aggregate/procedure snapshots; exact return classifiers; nine const positions and address temporaries; aliases versus nominal identity; enum/procedure-pointer/vararg types; C mangling meanings; target ranks/WCHAR remaps; fixed-string VAR/IDX/FIELD widths; pointer/unit/storage distinctions; full/reduced emission equality, binary/text parity, reset and corrected-total corruption. Evidence: named-flags-v25-complete.log and type-storage-classes-v25.log. All 15 changed-source v22 cases, three final mapper v23 cases, three type-closure v24 cases and three final dictionary v25 cases pass. The initial stronger NT checker also accepts all 15 saved v22 full models (normalized-replay-v24.json). Final v25 native smoke passes, compiler structure checks 297 files / 21 host graphs, and the binary contract matches. This is focused qualification, not overall completion.

Namespace/USING and binding-context observations pass five focused families plus the expanded nested/anonymous/scoped-enum/out-of-line context control. Exact C/LLVM/Clang emissions, native no-op results, source order, transitive and reopened imports, scoped removal/shadowing, repeated includes, expanded/inactive omissions, transport parity, module resets and recount-corrected corruptions are checked. All nine affected compiler-source cases pass with exact off/full/expression emissions and parser observations; native smoke passes. Logs: namespace-visibility-v20-complete.log, binding-scope-kinds-v20.log, self-namespace-v20.log, smoke-namespace-v20.log. Structure: 293 files / 21 host graphs; binary contract matches.

Frozen v14 complete contract suite finished with exit zero: 301 methods, four explicitly Windows-only skips on this Linux host. Evidence: verification-v14/contracts-status.json and contracts.log. This baseline predates shared-tree integration and the namespace additions; the new expanded run remains a distinct acceptance check.

Integration with shared commit 82f88cc90 builds as v17. The v16 integration run passed 24 of 25 families; its sole failed family was preprocessor receiver retention, repaired by replacing the earlier skip workaround with the explicit native PP context. Five v17 receiver/parser/enum/include families and native semantic smoke pass. Logs: integration-checks-v16.log, integration-final-v17.log, smoke-integration-v17.log. v14 assembler and target name controls pass GAS64/GAS (emission-asm-v14.log); additional C/Clang/LLVM TLS uncertainty, transport, native object and corruption controls pass (emission-tls-v14.log).
